theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_lsc_ibp_c1_ball
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (Φ : Fin n → Euclid n → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ i)) → (∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Φ i)) → (∀ i, tsupport (Φ i) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ h x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * Φ i x = -∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, h x * ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
